messages.subject: Error matrix percentage in rattle?
parts:
I have the following error matrix result from KSVM model:

Error matrix for the SVM model on Class_t.csv (counts):

      Predicted
Actual   0        1
     0     92      22
     1      8      139

Error matrix for the SVM model on Class_t.csv (%):

      Predicted
Actual  0  1
     0   35  8
     1    3  53
Overall error: 0.1149425

My question is: why the percentage (%) = 35 +53+ 3 + 8 =99% , why not 100% , what is wrong? 

I appreciate for any comment, txs!

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Error matrix percentage in rattle?
parts:
That's a rounding issue: 35.2 + 53.3 + 3.1 + 8.4 = 100

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
